techniques.acronym:

Connect each letter back to: apple

Or as a sentence (acrostic): Angry.
Swap in your own words; a silly sentence you made yourself sticks best.
techniques.story:
Mini-story:

1. Picture apple at the front door. It shines so you notice it before moving on.

Walk through the scenes in order and let each image cue the next idea.
techniques.peg:
Peg list:

1. One rhymes with sun: imagine apple stuck to a sun.

Say the number, hear the rhyme, see the picture.
techniques.palace:
Memory palace route:

1. Put apple at the front door. Make it oversized or moving.

Review by walking through the route in the same order. Use a home you know well.
techniques.chunk:
Chunk map:

Group 1: apple

Study one group at a time, then connect the groups.
techniques.chain:
Link chain:

Start with apple and add more ideas to build a chain.

1. Picture apple at the front door. It shines so you notice it before moving on.
2. Picture banana on the kitchen table. It speaks so you notice it before moving on.
3. Picture cherry beside a bright window. It spins so you notice it before moving on.

Walk through the scenes in order and let each image cue the next idea.
